description: Store the photo that will be printed on the poster, and return the photo_url to pass to create_poster_checkout. Only use a photo the user has given in THIS conversation. Never reuse a photo or link from memory or an earlier conversation, and never use a product or poster image. If the user hasn't given a photo yet, ask them for one instead of calling this. Give exactly one of: photo (a file the user attached in this chat), image_url (a public https link to the image), image_base64, or upload_id (from get_photo_upload_link, once the user says they've uploaded). If you can't send the user's photo any of these ways, call get_photo_upload_link instead of asking the user for a link. JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 20MB. Photos are kept for 12 months so the poster can be made and revised, then deleted automatically.

image_base64.description: The image file encoded as base64 (a data: URL prefix is fine).

image_url.description: Public https:// address of the image.

photo.description: A photo the user attached in this chat (ChatGPT file reference).

upload_id.description: The upload_id from get_photo_upload_link, after the user has uploaded on that page.
